digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion)
propositions: Local developer gates must be configured to resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles before the production cutover to avoid first-contact failure at scale.
Bedrock inference profiles are the only invokable model class in the account; direct on-demand model IDs return ValidationException.
Prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path (nonzero cache_read_tokens), not only write to cache, to prove the integration is functional.
Structured output must validate on all three local gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) run against Bedrock without fallback to unparsed or INDETERMINATE shapes.
A developer must be able to opt into Bedrock via a single environment variable (REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE) and revert to Anthropic by unsetting it in one step.
